answer: By the zenith of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, converted to a slow vesting stream, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
